label: neiso 36 weather floor
definition: Dual-limb temperature-correlated reliability floor (CT_PEAKER hot-limb TMAX; COAL/ST_GAS cold-limb TMIN), measured-schedule, WITH the documented NEISO-2025 hydro fix (--hydro-backfill-year 2024 --hydro-eia930-monthly): the early-release 2025 EIA-923 vintage under-counts conventional hydro (5 of ~166 plants, 0.09 of ~5.1 TWh), so the LP otherwise burns gas for the missing inflow. Supersedes neiso-35 (same floor, broken 2025 hydro). 2023/2024 clean (gas within ~0.1%, hydro matches); 2025 recovers C3a mean-LMP and C5a CO2 (both PASS, vs neiso-35 +12.7%/+13.7%). Residual C2 gas +4.3% (2025) is a gas-vs-oil dispatch gap (model oil 0.05 vs actual 1.24 TWh) + EIA-930 gas-benchmark fold-in, NOT the floor (net-gas-neutral in measured mode) or hydro. Does not outperform keeper neiso-33 (which passes C2), so not promoted.
